scenarios.name: headless-tools-subagent
scenarios.description: Isolated capture (--setting-sources project,local, --strict-mcp-config, no auto memory, no claude.ai connectors, synthetic project CLAUDE.md). claude -p with Haiku: Read of an existing file and of a missing one (PostToolUseFailure), Bash ls allowed, a file write that is not allowed (PermissionRequest, denied in -p), an Explore subagent. http hooks plus an async command hook for SessionStart; metrics, events and traces on.

scenarios.name: headless-sessionstart-http-ignored
scenarios.description: Isolated capture (--setting-sources project,local, --strict-mcp-config, no auto memory, no claude.ai connectors, synthetic project CLAUDE.md). SessionStart configured as an http hook (not supported): no SessionStart arrives and nothing is reported; the other events use http hooks.

scenarios.name: headless-async-command-transport
scenarios.description: Isolated capture (--setting-sources project,local, --strict-mcp-config, no auto memory, no claude.ai connectors, synthetic project CLAUDE.md). Every hook as an async command hook (curl, exec form). The Explore subagent ran in the background: PostToolUse(Agent) with status async_launched, the main Stop before the subagent finished, and the subagent's report arriving as UserPromptSubmit. Async delivery reordered events: PostToolUse(Agent) arrived before PreToolUse(Agent), and no SessionEnd arrived.

scenarios.name: interactive-permission-compact
scenarios.description: Isolated capture (--setting-sources project,local, --strict-mcp-config, no auto memory, no claude.ai connectors, synthetic project CLAUDE.md). Interactive session in default permission mode driven through a pseudo-terminal: permission dialog approved (PermissionRequest, Notification permission_prompt about 6 s later), a second dialog denied with Esc (no closing hook event; telemetry tool_decision reject/user_reject), /compact (PreCompact, an internal SubagentStop and PostCompact, plus a SessionStart with source=compact delivered asynchronously, so its position varies), /exit (SessionEnd prompt_input_exit).

scenarios.name: interactive-elicitation-idle
scenarios.description: Isolated capture (--setting-sources project,local, --strict-mcp-config, no auto memory, no claude.ai connectors, synthetic project CLAUDE.md). Interactive session: an MCP tool that requests elicitation, declined with Esc (Elicitation, Notification elicitation_dialog about 6 s later, ElicitationResult, Notification elicitation_response), then idle (Notification idle_prompt 60 s after Stop), then /exit.

scenarios.name: hooks-endpoint-down
scenarios.description: Isolated capture (--setting-sources project,local, --strict-mcp-config, no auto memory, no claude.ai connectors, synthetic project CLAUDE.md). http hooks pointing at a port with nothing listening: the session completes normally; hook_execution_complete reports num_non_blocking_error for each event. (In an exploratory run outside these fixtures, the transcript also got hook_non_blocking_error notices that were not sent to the model; see ADR 0011.)

scenarios.name: hooks-endpoint-timeout
scenarios.description: Isolated capture (--setting-sources project,local, --strict-mcp-config, no auto memory, no claude.ai connectors, synthetic project CLAUDE.md). Hook server sleeping 10 s with a 1 s hook timeout: each http hook is cancelled after the timeout (hook_execution_complete num_cancelled, total_duration_ms about 1000).
